scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.smoke:platform: pnpm hygiene && pnpm --filter @egov/shared build && pnpm --filter @egov/application build && pnpm --filter @egov/adapters-egov-platform smoke
scripts.build:android-sso-java: bash -c 'set -a; source .env; set +a; export ANDROID_HOME="$PWD/.local/android-sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; cd apps/android-sso-java && ./gradlew assembleDebug -PssoClientId="${EGOV_SSO_CLIENT_ID:-$EGOV_SSO_PARTNER_CODE}" -PssoApiBaseUrl="$EGOV_SSO_API_BASE_URL"'
